recent_posts.title: Kotlin Weekly #509
recent_posts.summary: Kotlin Weekly issue #509 curates articles, videos, and libraries from the Kotlin ecosystem. Highlights include a guide on migrating from Koin DSL to Koin Annotations in multimodule projects, tips for pure-Kotlin ViewModel testing without Android dependencies, OpenTelemetry observability in Spring Boot Kotlin apps, a case study of building a full-stack app with 100% Kotlin, the 1.0 stable release of Metro DI compiler plugin, and a critical take on LLMs in open-source maintenance. Libraries featured include COMInterop for Kotlin/Native, Splashify for Compose splash screens, RikkaUI (shadcn-inspired Compose components), and librootkotlinx for rooted Android code.

recent_posts.title: Kotlin Weekly #508
recent_posts.summary: Kotlin Weekly issue #508 curates the latest in the Kotlin ecosystem, featuring sponsored content for a Polished Compose UI course and a Compose cheat sheet. The libraries section highlights several new open-source projects including Halogen (LLM-powered Material 3 theming for Compose Multiplatform), ADB Friend (CLI tool for Android device management), Kotlin Validator (KSP-powered validation library), ComposePWA (Gradle plugin for PWA builds), ComposePdf (multiplatform PDF rendering), Android Skills MCP (AI coding assistant integration), a Shader Animation CMP demo, and ParticleEmitter (physics-based Compose animations).

recent_posts.title: Kotlin Weekly #507
recent_posts.summary: Kotlin Weekly issue #507 covers news including JetBrains' Koog integration for Spring AI with type-safe graph workflows, Android 17 Beta 4, and the upcoming Google I/O schedule. Articles highlight production lessons for serverless AI agents using Koog and AWS Lambda, Koin Compiler Plugin 1.0.0-RC1 with compile-time dependency injection safety, shader implementation in Compose Multiplatform, a ViewModel simplification pattern for KMP, Kotlin Multiplatform observability with Kotzilla SDK, new Kotlin 2.4.0 sorted-order validation extensions, and a Compose hot reload tool. Libraries section features Materia, a KMP 3D engine supporting WebGPU and Vulkan.

recent_posts.title: Kotlin Weekly #505

recent_posts.title: Kotlin Weekly #500
recent_posts.summary: Issue #500 of Kotlin Weekly curates articles, libraries, and sponsored content for the Kotlin community. Highlights include a deep dive on slashing IntelliJ sync times by 97% for a 2,000-module codebase, a guide to using unit tests as documentation for Koin DI, and a tutorial on building a self-hosted TTS service with Kotlin and ONNX Runtime. Library releases cover Kotlin Multiplatform bindings for FoundationDB, a compile-time reflection library (Inspekt), a minimalist faking framework (Mockingbird), and an on-device AI bridge exposing FoundationModels as an OpenAI-compatible REST API. Sponsored content promotes Compose cheat sheets and the Advanced Compose course.
